landing.action.description: Button revealed the moment check-in opens.

landing.closed.body.description: Line under the heading of the page that replaces the whole site once the event is over. Passes, check-in and the questionnaire are no longer available; it is read by anyone opening an old link, including after the event's data has been deleted.

landing.closed.title.description: Heading of the page that replaces the whole site once the event is over.

landing.days.description: Unit word beside the number of whole days left, which is shown separately just before it. Hidden once less than a day is left. days is that number.

landing.lede.description: Headline of the countdown page shown before check-in opens.

landing.opensAt.description: When check-in opens, in the event's timezone. date is the weekday and day; time is the time of day, already formatted.

landing.reopening.defaultMessage: Check-in will be available in a moment.
landing.reopening.description: Shown in place of the countdown when it reaches zero while the app is temporarily served by the standalone fallback. The page reloads itself until the real check-in is back. Must read true both at the moment check-in first opens and hours into the event, so it promises neither an opening nor a return.

landing.unit.hours.description: Label under the hours tile of the countdown. Kept terse: the whole countdown is hidden from assistive technology.

landing.unit.minutes.description: Label under the minutes tile of the countdown. Kept terse, like the other tile labels.

landing.unit.seconds.description: Label under the seconds tile of the countdown. Kept terse, like the other tile labels.
